regime.label: Cautious: inflation and rate-hike risk
regime.summary: Hot September CPI and a 1.3% jump in producer prices revived Fed hike fears, pushing the 10-year yield above 5%. Money is rotating out of AI and long-duration tech into value, energy, banks and defensives, while oil near $98 on Middle East tension adds to inflation pressure. Breadth is improving, so this reads as rotation more than a broad selloff.
